correctness.rationale: The proof localizes the event to ||X||≤K theta ||Y||, justifies limit interchange with an integrable kth-moment domination, converts the singular limit by an exact right orthogonal rotation, and computes the condition-number sublevel volume via the determinant-to-trace criterion. The boundary is a proper null algebraic hypersurface for nonzero Y. The k=2,3 Gaussian constants have independent exact rational numerical checks; experiments do not replace the proof. No unproved infinite-time or all-dimensional extrapolations.

value.rationale: The threshold acceptance event is directly motivated by actual algorithmic use of sketched basis condition numbers. The theorem identifies its sharp false-safe probability exponent k, computable leading constant and precise non-Gaussian universality under natural moment and density assumptions. This is a structural rare-event law with a concrete reliability interpretation, beyond a routine algebraic restatement; it explicitly excludes structured-sketch or multi-step guarantees.
